column3: Although 容易 means easy, the phrase means it was hard, and the shorter 好容易 means exactly the same. It usually comes before 才, as in 好不容易才找到, to say you finally managed it.
column4: 我好不容易才找到这家店。
column5: 我好不容易才找到這家店。
column6: Wǒ hǎobùróngyì cái zhǎodào zhè jiā diàn.
column7: I had a hard time finding this shop.

column3: Very common as a polite excuse when you can't come or must leave (我有事, 先走了). 没事 is the opposite: nothing is wrong, never mind.
column6: Wǒ jīntiān yǒushì, bù néng qù.
column7: I have something to do today, so I can't go.
